Method of Attack: Ransomware attacks using modified Conti ransomware source code
Ransom notes blaming Vladimir Putin and demanding ransom
Impacted Systems: Russian organizations including Tensor (document management operator)
VGTRK (state-owned Russian Television and Radio broadcaster)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of leaked Conti ransomware source code
Indicators of Compromise: Data leak of 786.2 GB including 900,000 emails and 4,000 files published on DDoS Secrets website
